mapper.select: SELECT FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_security_state WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_key = #{targetKey} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_security_state WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND ((target_type = 'REALM' AND target_key = 'self') OR (target_type = 'CLIENT' AND target_key = #{clientKey}) OR (target_type = 'SUBJECT' AND target_key = #{subject})) ORDER BY target_type, target_key
SELECT FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_security_state WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_key = #{targetKey} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_security_state WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (revision > #{afterRevision} OR (revision = #{afterRevision} AND id > #{afterId})) ORDER BY revision ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_security_state WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE tianquan_oauth.oauth_security_state SET generation = #{po.generation}, enabled = #{po.enabled}, revision = #{po.revision}, directory_subject_revision = #{po.directorySubjectRevision}, directory_subject_ordered_revision = #{po.directorySubjectOrderedRevision}, directory_subject_fingerprint = #{po.directorySubjectFingerprint,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reason_code = #{po.reasonCode}, version = #{po.version}, update_user_id = #{po.updateUserId}, update_time = #{po.updateTime} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{po.id} AND target_type = #{po.targetType} AND target_key = #{po.targetKey} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE tianquan_oauth.oauth_security_state s SET version = s.version + 1, update_user_id = #{actor}, update_time = #{now} WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.id = #{id} AND s.version = #{expectedVersion} AND s.target_type = 'REALM' AND s.target_key = 'self' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_security_state subject_state WHERE subject_state.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND subject_state.target_type = 'SUBJECT' AND subject_state.target_key = #{subject} AND subject_state.deleted_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_authorization a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.principal_name = #{subject} AND a.principal_type = 'USER' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_authentication auth WHERE auth.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND auth.subject = #{subject} AND auth.deleted_at IS NULL)
